entries.automatedTestTitle: Case ID:ATL-001 - List Lifecycle Events → that exception list creation is captured in the audit trail with complete metadata.
Case ID:ATL-002 - List Lifecycle Events → Check that editing an exception list writes a new immutable audit event.
Case ID:ATL-003 - List Lifecycle Events → that list suspension is recorded with the correct status change.
Case ID:ATL-004 - List Lifecycle Events → that re-activation of a list is logged as a separate event.
Case ID:ATL-005 - List Lifecycle Events → that deleting an exception list leaves a permanent audit record.
Case ID:ATL-006 - Entry Lifecycle Events → Ensure that exception entry submission is captured in the audit trail.
Case ID:ATL-007 - Entry Lifecycle Events → Check that approving an exception entry creates a separate audit trail record.
Case ID:ATL-008 - Entry Lifecycle Events → that rejection of an exception entry is written to the audit history.
Case ID:ATL-009 - Entry Lifecycle Events → that entry edit activity is tracked even when only a single field changes.
Case ID:ATL-010 - Entry Lifecycle Events → that entry suspension is logged when a user deactivates an approved entry.
Case ID:ATL-011 - Entry Lifecycle Events → Check that entry re-activation after suspension is audited separately from the original approval.
Case ID:ATL-012 - TTL & Bulk Events → Ensure that expired entries still remain visible in the audit trail after TTL passes.
Case ID:ATL-013 - TTL & Bulk Events → that bulk upload submission creates a parent audit event.
Case ID:ATL-014 - TTL & Bulk Events → that bulk upload approval or rejection is recorded together with the batch outcome.
Case ID:ATL-015 - TTL & Bulk Events → Check that API submit, update, and delete events are logged with the caller identity.
Case ID:ATL-016 - Suppression Logging → that every suppressed alert is logged silently without user-facing notification noise.
Case ID:ATL-017 - Suppression Logging → that suppression logging includes the watchlist, score, and screening timestamps.
Case ID:ATL-018 - Evidence Access Logging → Check that evidence attachment upload is recorded in the audit trail.
Case ID:ATL-019 - Evidence Access Logging → that viewing or downloading evidence is separately logged.
Case ID:ATL-020 - Integrity & Conflict Events → Ensure that a material identity change auto-suspension event is captured.
Case ID:ATL-021 - Integrity & Conflict Events → that a true-hit conflict check blocked submission is recorded as an integrity event.
Case ID:ATL-022 - Report & Export Events → that the exception register report generation is logged.
Case ID:ATL-023 - Report & Export Events → Check that exporting the audit trail to CSV is itself logged.
Case ID:ATL-024 - Report & Export Events → that audit records are read-only and cannot be edited through the application.
Case ID:ATL-025 - Report & Export Events → Ensure that audit records remain searchable after the retention period is configured.
Case ID:ATL-026 - Event Logging & Retention → Check that the audit trail shows before and after state snapshots for state-changing actions.
Case ID:ATL-027 - Search & Filters → audit trail filters by event type, list, and date range per Figma.
Case ID:ATL-028 - Auditor Access Control → Read-Only Auditor has read/export access only on audit trail.
Case ID:ATL-029 - Access Control → MLRO and Compliance Manager have full read access to all audit records.
Case ID:ATL-030 - Access Control → non-privileged roles see only audit records related to their own submissions.
Case ID:EEM-001 - Data Model & Field Validation → Check that a new exception entry cannot be submitted when any mandatory field is left blank.
Case ID:EEM-002 - Data Model & Field Validation → the conditional behaviour for Original Script Name and Script Type when a non-Latin name is entered.
Case ID:EEM-003 - Add Entry → Create a fresh exception entry from the list screen and confirm that it goes through maker-checker approval.
Case ID:EEM-004 - Add Entry → Use the alert-driven path and verify that the entry form is prefilled from the screening alert.
Case ID:EEM-005 - Add Entry → Block the submission when the customer is already present on an active Custom List or blacklist.
Case ID:EEM-006 - Add Entry → Check the warning path when the distinguishing evidence is too thin but the user chooses to continue.
Case ID:EEM-007 - Edit Entry → Update an approved entry and verify that the change is sent back through the approval workflow.
Case ID:EEM-008 - Edit Entry → Make sure an entry sitting in Pending Approval cannot be edited until the request is resolved.
Case ID:EEM-009 - Edit Entry → that scope expansion sends the edit to a higher approval level than a simple reduction.
Case ID:EEM-010 - Suspend / Delete Entry → Suspend a live entry and confirm that suppression stops as soon as the approval is completed.
Case ID:EEM-011 - Suspend / Delete Entry → Soft-delete an entry and verify that the system keeps the record for audit and history review.
Case ID:EEM-012 - TTL & Entry Renewal → that the pre-expiry reminder workflow fires before the TTL runs out.

Case ID:EEM-014 - TTL & Entry Renewal → Renew an expired entry and ensure the new request follows the standard approval cycle.
Case ID:EEM-015 - Bulk Upload → Upload a clean CSV batch and verify that the import reaches the approval stage with the correct summary.
Case ID:EEM-016 - Bulk Upload → Check how the system handles a mixed file that contains both valid and invalid rows.
Case ID:EEM-017 - API Synchronisation → that create, update, and delete actions received through API calls are captured in the audit trail.
Case ID:EEM-018 - API Synchronisation → Push the API request rate past the configured limit and confirm that throttling kicks in.
Case ID:EEM-019 - Add Entry → that a partially completed exception entry can be saved as Draft without entering the approval workflow.
Case ID:EEM-020 - Add Entry → that a Draft with missing mandatory fields cannot be submitted for approval.
Case ID:EEM-021 - Add Entry → that a saved Draft can be edited and updated values are retained.
Case ID:EEM-022 - Add Entry → that invalid updates in Draft prevent successful submission.
Case ID:EEM-023 - Add Entry → that a completed Draft can be submitted and routed to Maker-Checker approval.
Case ID:EEM-024 - Data Model & Field Validation → IP Address/CIDR and IP Validity Period validate for IP Range exception type.
Case ID:EEM-025 - Data Model & Field Validation → Mobile Number enforces E.164 format when exception type is Mobile Number.
Case ID:EEM-026 - Add Entry → Reason Detail enforces minimum 50 and maximum 2,000 characters.
Case ID:EEM-027 - Add Entry → Other reason code requires 200+ chars in Reason Detail and MLRO checker routing.
Case ID:EEM-028 - Add Entry → checker requirement hint on entry form per Figma (CO/CM vs MLRO).
Case ID:EEM-029 - Suspend / Delete Entry → Re-activate for suspended entries routes through maker-checker with mandatory reason.
Case ID:EEM-030 - TTL & Entry Renewal → Renew on expired entry creates new approval submission.
Case ID:EEM-031 - TTL & Entry Renewal → material identity change auto-suspends entries within 15 minutes.
Case ID:EEM-032 - Bulk Upload → bulk upload duplicate detection for same customer ID and watchlist scope.
Case ID:EEM-033 - Bulk Upload → checker can drill into bulk upload rows before batch approval.
Case ID:EEM-034 - Edit Entry → View History panel shows submission, approval, and suppression events per Figma.
Case ID:EEM-035 - Add Entry → match score colour-coded badge in entry grid per Figma.
Case ID:EEM-036 - API Synchronisation → POST /csel/conflict-check blocks conflicting customer ID before submission.
Case ID:EEM-037 - API Synchronisation → API bulk endpoint accepts up to 500 entries per call.
Case ID:EEM-038 - Add Entry → KYC onboarding flagged Pending CSEL Approval on onboarding exception submit.
Case ID:EEM-039 - Data Model & Field Validation → Script Type values AR, ZH-CN, ZH-TW, CY, LA per FSD.
Case ID:EEM-040 - Suspend / Delete Entry → bulk suspend/delete of multiple entries is not supported per FSD.
Case ID:EEM-041 - Data Model & Field Validation → Jurisdiction Scope optional field limits exception application to specified jurisdiction when populated.
Case ID:EEM-042 - Data Model & Field Validation → Email Address conditional field validates format when alert was triggered by email match.
Case ID:EEM-043 - Add Entry → True Hit confirmed alert cannot be submitted to CSEL per FSD scope.
Case ID:EEM-044 - Add Entry → entry can be initiated from Case Management with evidence reference linked to source case.
Case ID:EEM-045 - Bulk Upload → Download Template from bulk upload returns XLSX with all mandatory columns per FSD.
Case ID:EEM-046 - API Synchronisation → GET /csel/{listId}/entries returns paginated filtered results for API client.
Case ID:EEM-047 - API Synchronisation → GET /csel/{listId}/entries/{entryId}/audit returns full entry audit history.

Case ID:ELM-001 - Landing Page → exception list landing page opens with updated summary cards (Total lists, Active lists, Total exceptions, Pending approval), status tabs, list grid columns (including Exp 30d/Expired), and row actions per FSD v1.1 and Figma v3.

Case ID:ELM-009 - Edit Exception List → Check that the list category stays locked after creation and cannot be changed during edit.

Case ID:ELM-014 - Landing Page → that landing page counters recalculate correctly after entry status changes.
Case ID:ELM-015 - Landing Page → that dashboard counters update after approval and rejection actions.
Case ID:ELM-016 - Landing Page → that dashboard counters remain consistent after page refresh and re-login.
Case ID:ELM-017 - Create Exception List → that List Name accepts exactly 100 characters.
Case ID:ELM-018 - Create Exception List → that List Name exceeding 100 characters is rejected.
Case ID:ELM-019 - Create Exception List → that Description accepts exactly 500 characters.
Case ID:ELM-020 - Create Exception List → that Description exceeding 500 characters is rejected.
Case ID:ELM-021 - Landing Page → landing page summary cards display Total lists, Active lists, Total exceptions, and Pending approval per updated Figma.
Case ID:ELM-022 - Landing Page → list status tabs (Active, Suspended, All) filter the landing grid per updated Figma.
Case ID:ELM-023 - Landing Page → landing grid columns include Exp 30d and Expired entry counters per FSD and Figma.
Case ID:ELM-024 - Create Exception List → Create Exception List supports Save as draft without entering maker-checker queue.
Case ID:ELM-025 - Create Exception List → Notify Compliance Officer and Auto-expire entries at TTL toggles persist on create form.
Case ID:ELM-026 - Create Exception List → Reason for Creation is mandatory and retained in audit log per FSD.
Case ID:ELM-027 - Create Exception List → 24 months default TTL option enforces MLRO sign-off requirement per FSD.
Case ID:ELM-028 - Landing Page → pagination supports 10, 25, 50, and 100 rows per page per FSD.
Case ID:ELM-029 - Landing Page → Bulk upload is accessible from landing page header per updated Figma.
Case ID:ELM-030 - Landing Page → sidebar menu search filters navigation items per updated Figma shell.
Case ID:ERR-001 - Executive Summary → that the report opens with the correct summary cards and section layout.
Case ID:ERR-002 - Executive Summary → Check that the total active exceptions count matches the data shown in the report table.
Case ID:ERR-003 - Executive Summary → the New This Month metric against newly created exception items.
Case ID:ERR-004 - Executive Summary → that the Suppressions This Month metric increments when alerts are suppressed.
Case ID:ERR-005 - Executive Summary → Check the Expiring Within 30 Days count and sample list entries.
Case ID:ERR-006 - Reason Code Analysis → that the Entries by Reason Code breakdown is displayed with percentages.
Case ID:ERR-007 - Reason Code Analysis → that clicking a reason code row opens the corresponding filtered view or detail context.
Case ID:ERR-008 - Watchlist Analysis → Check that the watchlist analysis section shows the correct top watchlist sources.
Case ID:ERR-009 - Export & Delivery → that the report export button creates a CSV file with the same visible data.
Case ID:ERR-010 - Export & Delivery → that the PDF export mirrors the report layout and includes the header information.
Case ID:ERR-011 - Filters & Pagination → that filters for list name or category narrow the report results correctly.
Case ID:ERR-012 - Filters & Pagination → Check that status filters return the expected list states such as Active or Suspended.
Case ID:ERR-013 - Filters & Pagination → the page-size control so the report shows the requested number of rows.
Case ID:ERR-014 - Filters & Pagination → that pagination navigates between report pages without losing the selected filters.
Case ID:ERR-015 - Data Integrity & Layout → Check that date-related values are displayed in the expected report format.
Case ID:ERR-016 - Data Integrity & Layout → that very long list names do not break the report layout.
Case ID:ERR-017 - Data Integrity & Layout → Check that special characters and punctuation in list names are rendered safely.
Case ID:ERR-018 - Data Integrity & Layout → that the report handles an empty result set with a proper no-data message.
Case ID:ERR-019 - Permissions & Refresh → that a user without report permission cannot export or view the register data.
Case ID:ERR-020 - Permissions & Refresh → Check that the report refreshes to show recent screening activity after new events occur.
Case ID:ERR-021 - Permissions & Refresh → that report values are consistent across screen refresh and browser reopen.
Case ID:ERR-022 - Performance & Period Selection → Check that the report summary does not mix current month and historical month totals.
Case ID:ERR-023 - Performance & Period Selection → that the report can be opened without visible performance lag on a normal dataset.
Case ID:ERR-024 - Performance & Period Selection → that the report header shows the correct month label and delivery context.
Case ID:ERR-025 - Performance & Period Selection → Check that the report keeps the visible list ordering when no sort is changed.
Case ID:ERR-026 - Executive Summary → Executive Summary includes renewals, expiries, and pending requests per FSD.
Case ID:ERR-027 - Suppression Activity Log → Suppression Activity Log groups suppressions by exception entry.
Case ID:ERR-028 - Expired Entries Section → Entries Expired This Month confirms suppression ceased and alerts resumed.
Case ID:ERR-029 - Active Entries Listing → Active Exception Entries full list section shows required columns per FSD.
Case ID:ERR-030 - Pending Requests Section → Pending Requests section lists outstanding maker-checker approvals at report generation date.
Case ID:EVAL-001 - Evaluation Criteria → that a screening hit is suppressed only when the customer ID, watchlist scope, status, and expiry checks all pass together.
Case ID:EVAL-002 - Evaluation Criteria → that a watchlist outside the configured scope does not suppress the alert even when the customer ID matches.
Case ID:EVAL-003 - Evaluation Criteria → that a suspended exception entry is ignored during evaluation even when the rest of the data matches.
Case ID:EVAL-004 - Evaluation Criteria → that an expired exception does not suppress a new hit after the expiry date has passed.
Case ID:EVAL-005 - Evaluation Criteria → Check the boundary case where the expiry date is exactly today and no suppression should be applied.
Case ID:EVAL-006 - Evaluation Criteria → Ensure that a customer ID mismatch blocks suppression even when the name and watchlist appear to match.
Case ID:EVAL-007 - Evaluation Criteria → that a missing customer ID on the alert does not allow the exception to suppress the hit.
Case ID:EVAL-008 - Evaluation Criteria → Check that a blank watchlist scope on the exception record prevents suppression.
Case ID:EVAL-009 - Evaluation Criteria → that inactive or draft status records are ignored during evaluation.
Case ID:EVAL-010 - Evaluation Criteria → that one valid exception among multiple candidate records is enough to suppress the hit.
Case ID:EVAL-011 - Evaluation Criteria → that the suppression event is written to audit when an alert is successfully suppressed.
Case ID:EVAL-012 - Fuzzy Matching → that a small spelling change still matches when the score stays above the configured threshold.
Case ID:EVAL-013 - Fuzzy Matching → that a name variation below the configured threshold does not apply the exception.
Case ID:EVAL-014 - Fuzzy Matching → Check the boundary case where the match score is exactly equal to the configured threshold.
Case ID:EVAL-015 - Fuzzy Matching → that phonetic matching catches a sound-alike name even when the spelling is different.
Case ID:EVAL-016 - Fuzzy Matching → Ensure that fuzzy matching never overrides an exact customer ID mismatch.
Case ID:EVAL-017 - Fuzzy Matching → that leading and trailing spaces do not break a valid fuzzy name match.
Case ID:EVAL-018 - Fuzzy Matching → Check that a case-only difference does not stop a valid name comparison.
Case ID:EVAL-019 - Fuzzy Matching → that punctuation changes such as hyphens or apostrophes are handled without a false negative.
Case ID:EVAL-020 - Fuzzy Matching → Check that an inserted or missing middle name is still evaluated correctly by the matching engine.
Case ID:EVAL-021 - Fuzzy Matching → behaviour for a very long customer name so the matching logic does not fail on length.
Case ID:EVAL-022 - Fuzzy Matching → that names containing diacritics or special characters are handled safely.
Case ID:EVAL-023 - Fuzzy Matching → Ensure that an empty incoming name cannot be used to trigger a false suppression.
Case ID:EVAL-024 - Fuzzy Matching → Check that a common short-form spelling does not bypass the customer ID rule.
Case ID:EVAL-025 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that Arabic-script names are matched correctly when the alert and the exception both carry the original script.
Case ID:EVAL-026 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → Arabic prefix handling for names such as Al-, El-, Bin-, and Bint-.
Case ID:EVAL-027 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that an Arabic-script alert does not get suppressed when the exception stores only a Latin transliteration.
Case ID:EVAL-028 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → Check that mixed Latin and Arabic text is stored and displayed without breaking UTF-8 handling.
Case ID:EVAL-029 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that Simplified Chinese names are matched exactly when both sides use the same script.
Case ID:EVAL-030 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that Traditional Chinese text is handled as a separate script and matched correctly when stored the same way.
Case ID:EVAL-031 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that Cyrillic names are matched correctly without losing characters during processing.
Case ID:EVAL-032 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that the system stores and renders UTF-8 characters without corruption after evaluation.
Case ID:EVAL-033 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → Check that the engine uses the Latin name when the alert arrives in Latin script and the exception stores both versions.
Case ID:EVAL-034 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that whitespace differences in a multilingual name do not cause a false mismatch.
Case ID:EVAL-035 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → Ensure that a multilingual entry with multiple name representations still suppresses the hit when the correct version matches.
Case ID:EVAL-036 - Fuzzy Matching → Check that a threshold change on the exception list immediately affects the decision outcome.
Case ID:EVAL-037 - Evaluation Criteria → that the engine selects the valid active entry when duplicate entries exist for the same customer and watchlist.
Case ID:EVAL-038 - Evaluation Criteria → that an exception is not applied when the customer data is incomplete even though the watchlist matches.
Case ID:EVAL-039 - Fuzzy Matching → Check that the system does not suppress a hit when the name score is close to, but still below, the threshold after normalisation.
Case ID:EVAL-040 - Native Script & Multilingual Matching → that multilingual search results remain stable after switching between screens or refreshing the page.
Case ID:EVAL-041 - Evaluation Criteria → evaluation is binary — partial criteria match never suppresses alert.
Case ID:MCW-001 - Checker Role Enforcement → that the Approve and Reject actions are not available to a user who does not have a permitted checker role for a standard CSEL request.
Case ID:MCW-002 - Checker Role Enforcement → that a Compliance Officer can approve a standard exception request when the user holds the correct checker role.
Case ID:MCW-003 - Checker Role Enforcement → that a Compliance Manager can approve a standard request in the same way as a Compliance Officer.
Case ID:MCW-004 - Checker Role Enforcement → Ensure that a peer analyst cannot process a request even if the user can open the queue screen.
Case ID:MCW-005 - Checker Role Enforcement → Check that a PEP-related request can be approved only by the MLRO or a designated deputy.
Case ID:MCW-006 - Checker Role Enforcement → that an exception entry tagged with the 'Other' reason code is restricted to MLRO approval only.
Case ID:MCW-007 - Checker Role Enforcement → that renewal of an entry older than 12 months is routed to MLRO approval.
Case ID:MCW-008 - Queue Views & Ownership → Check that a request submitted by the logged-in user is listed under My Requests and not presented for self-approval.
Case ID:MCW-009 - Queue Views & Ownership → Ensure that a checker cannot approve their own request even when the checker role matches the request type.
Case ID:MCW-010 - Queue Views & Ownership → that All Requests shows every pending item that is waiting for checker action.
Case ID:MCW-011 - Queue Views & Ownership → that the queue list is refreshed after an approval so the approved item disappears from the pending view.

Case ID:MCW-013 - Approval / Rejection Handling → that rejecting a request changes its workflow state to Rejected and prevents the exception from becoming active.
Case ID:MCW-014 - Approval / Rejection Handling → Check that a rejection cannot be submitted without a clear reason or comment when the process requires justification.
Case ID:MCW-015 - Approval / Rejection Handling → Ensure that two approval attempts on the same request are not processed twice.
Case ID:MCW-016 - Approval / Rejection Handling → that a rejected request cannot be moved back to pending from the checker screen without a fresh maker submission.
Case ID:MCW-017 - SLA & Escalation → that the onboarding SLA countdown starts from the maker submission timestamp and not from the time the request was opened.
Case ID:MCW-018 - SLA & Escalation → Check that an onboarding request shows the 12-hour escalation warning before the 24-hour SLA breach.
Case ID:MCW-019 - SLA & Escalation → that an onboarding request crossing the 24-hour SLA produces the required escalation notification path.
Case ID:MCW-020 - SLA & Escalation → that periodic re-screening and event-driven requests use the 48-hour SLA rule.
Case ID:MCW-021 - SLA & Escalation → the 24-hour escalation warning for periodic and event-driven requests before the 48-hour breach.
Case ID:MCW-022 - SLA & Escalation → Check that escalation notifications are generated only once for the same request at the configured SLA threshold.

Case ID:MCW-024 - Special Approval Rules → that a request submitted by a maker is shown to the checker with the correct pending state and not auto-approved by system refresh.
Case ID:MCW-025 - Special Approval Rules → Check that simultaneous approval attempts from two sessions do not create conflicting workflow states.
Case ID:MCW-026 - Approval / Rejection Handling → checker approval success modal shows action, submitter, timestamp, Pending status per Figma.
Case ID:MCW-027 - Approval / Rejection Handling → mandatory comment modal blocks proceed without comment per Figma.
Case ID:MCW-028 - Queue Views & Ownership → MC request cards show SLA timer, urgency, and escalation warning per Figma.
Case ID:MCW-029 - Approval / Rejection Handling → bulk upload card shows entry count and supports drill-down.
Case ID:MCW-030 - Checker Role Enforcement → PEP exception list enforces MLRO as checker for all entries at list configuration level.
